annotations.title: Create an itinerary link for the Meridian Dispatch app

description: Generate an itinerary import link: turn a day-by-day travel itinerary into a shareable "Add Itinerary to Meridian Dispatch" link. Use it when the traveller has a day-by-day plan and wants it in the Meridian Dispatch app, or asks for a link to their trip. It is the only tool that creates anything; the others only read. To draft the plan itself, use get_destination, get_dispatch and get_place first and link places with their meridiandispatch.com URLs. Opening the link on an iPhone with the Meridian Dispatch app shows the trip and adds it to the Plan tab as a new plan, after the traveller picks the first day; anywhere else it opens a web preview of the days. Days are numbered (day 1, 2, 3) or dated, and every day needs a hotel stay. A place given with its meridiandispatch.com page URL arrives with that page's field record. Each call creates a new, public, permanent link (not idempotent): booking references, emails and phone numbers are removed. Returns the link, ready-made markdown, counts of days and items, and the places matched and not matched to the guides. An invalid itinerary returns an error listing every problem; too many links in an hour returns a rate-limit error.

country_code.description: ISO 3166 alpha-2 code of the main country, e.g. "ME".

days.description: The days in order, each with what to do. Number every day or date every day, not a mix.

city.description: Where the traveller is that day, e.g. "Kotor".

country_code.description: ISO alpha-2, when this day is in a different country.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Use this or day on every day.

day.description: Day number, from 1. Use this or date on every day.

items.description: The day's places and activities, in order.

category.description: The kind of place, e.g. "Museum" or "Beach".

kind.description: activity (a place or thing to do), restaurant (somewhere to eat) or note (a reminder with no place).

lat.description: Latitude, when there is no meridian_url.

lng.description: Longitude, when there is no meridian_url.

meridian_url.description: The meridiandispatch.com page for this place, when there is one (from search_guides or get_destination). The place then arrives with its location and record.

part_of_day.description: When in the day, if there is no exact time.

title.description: The place or activity, e.g. "Kotor Old Town".

stays.description: Where the traveller sleeps, by hotel name. Required: every day must fall between a stay's check-in and check-out (inclusive), or the app shows that day without its places. check_in_day and check_out_day on a numbered itinerary, check_in and check_out (YYYY-MM-DD) on a dated one.

check_in_day.description: Numbered itinerary: the day number of check-in.

check_out_day.description: Numbered itinerary: the day number of check-out.

city.description: The town the hotel is in.

summary.description: One short paragraph shown under the title: what the trip is and why it works.

title.description: The trip, e.g. "Six days on the Montenegro coast".

name: create_itinerary_link

unmatched_places.description: Places that matched nothing in the guides; resend with the proper name to attach a location.

url.description: The link to give the traveller.
